versions.changelog: Key description names both ways to get a key again: the free key page at app.sentisense.ai/get-api-key, or a temporary key with no signup.
The API key is now optional to load this skill, so an agent with no key can follow the No key yet steps for a temporary free key.
New init command (CLI 0.66.0): prints a temporary key with no signup and a keep link; commands now pin sentisense 0.66.0.

Pins the CLI at 0.63.1 in every command, and says what exit 5 means now: the per-minute limit says how long to wait, while a used-up monthly allowance says it resets at the start of next month, so do not retry it.
Clearer description of what the CLI covers.
Declares permissions, sets the API origin explicitly on every command, reads the key from the environment instead of an argument, and drops the claim that pinning verifies the artifact.
Pins one command-line version throughout and states plainly what npx runs.

Three commands new in sentisense CLI 0.52.0: analysts <ticker> --coverage (who covers a stock, whole-book rating counts then one row per firm with the named analyst and slug), analyst <slug> [--calls] (one analyst's firms, coverage book and call history; slug only), and search <name> [--type company] (resolve a company, fund, person or product name to the symbol and slug the other commands take; no match exits 4). Pin 0.52.0.
Pin 0.47.1: health and auth output now fully redact the API key
Commands pin 0.46.0: the insiders summary now separates open-market selling from tax withholding.
Pin the CLI to an immutable published version; clarify local key storage is optional and removable
The official CLI skill: quickstart, commands, output modes, exit codes, and optional caller identity
